description:
• Brand Introduction:

Library Tales Publishing is a leading independent book publishing company dedicated to producing high-quality books across multiple genres, including art, self-help, business, and children's literature. With a strong reputation in the industry, we specialize in helping authors bring their stories to life while delivering valuable content to readers worldwide.

• Product Description:

Our flagship series, How to Draw Cool Stuff, has sold over 1 million copies online, making it a best-seller among aspiring artists, students, and teachers. We publish books that inspire, educate, and engage audiences across different age groups and interests. Whether it's a practical guide to drawing, a motivational business book, or an enchanting children’s story, our catalog is designed to appeal to a wide range of readers.

• USP (Unique Selling Point):

  • 📖 Best-Selling Books with Proven Demand – Promote books that have already gained massive popularity and strong sales.
  • 🎯 Perfect for Artists, Educators & Entrepreneurs – Our books cater to creative individuals and professionals looking for engaging, high-quality content.
  • 💡 Exclusive Affiliate Discounts & Bonuses – Affiliates may gain access to special offers that increase conversion rates.
  • 📈 Easy-to-Track Performance & Earnings – Get real-time insights into your referrals, commissions, and payouts.
  • 🤝 Strong Brand Reputation – Library Tales Publishing has an established presence in the book industry, making it easier to promote and sell our titles.

• Payment Terms:

  • 💰 Commission Rate: 10% per sale (excluding taxes and shipping)
  • 💵 Payment Method: PayPal
  • ⏳ Payment Schedule: Payments are processed within 30 days, calculated at the end of each month

• Other Information:

  • 🏆 Who Can Join? – Ideal for book lovers, influencers, educators, artists, content creators, and entrepreneurs.
  • 🌍 Where Can You Promote? – Social media, YouTube, blogs, email newsletters, and more!
  • 📣 Marketing Support – We provide banners, promotional graphics, and tips to help you succeed.
  • 🚀 Sign Up for Free & Start Earning Today!
